name: Bing Wallpaper
tagline: 必应每日壁纸，自动更换桌面背景
taglineEn: Bing's daily wallpaper, automatically changing your desktop background
description: 微软官方出品的壁纸工具，每天自动把必应首页的精选图片设为桌面壁纸，并附带图片出处信息卡片，也可以手动翻看往期图片。给教室大屏换个好看的背景，开机就有新鲜感。
descriptionEn: Microsoft's official wallpaper tool automatically sets Bing's daily featured image as your desktop wallpaper, with an information card about the image and the ability to browse past images. Give classroom displays a fresh look every day.
author: Microsoft

downloads.platform: 通过 Microsoft Store 下载
